title: S4: Feature-budget cap after steering; runtime steering-prompt override
description:
## Purpose

Keep steering within the ladder's feature budget and give non-planted corpora a neutral steering prompt.

## Scope

After steering, cap new elements to the ladder budget (n/5 at 30-199 labels, max 20 at 100-199; n/10 at 200-999): drop lowest-ranked new elements and record what was dropped. Reworded copy of `steer_scorecard.tac` under `var/` for non-planted corpora (no 'positive and negative examples'); point `jev_flywheel.steer.PROCEDURE` at it at runtime and record its sha256. Planted runs use the original file byte for byte; pinned clone cd4a4886 stays clean.

## Specs (first, beside the module)

cap drops lowest-ranked and records them; no-op under budget; override applied only for emotion and its sha256 recorded; planted uses the original procedure.

## Reuse

`feature_budget` in the clone's `fit.py` / `ladder.py` (read-only).

## Definition of done

Cap and override specs pass; planted replays byte-identical again; clone `git status` clean.

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)

comments.text: Done offline in commit 4bfaf85 (not pushed). Added unified_budget.py (feature-cap planner: drops whole elements from the end, never holistic; reserved features for B/A+B), Harness._cap_to_budget after steering in workspace arms (prunes workspace scorecard, refits, records feature_cap in the round output only when something was dropped), unified_steering_prompt.py (two documented exact substitutions on the pinned .tac, written under var/unified-flywheel/steering-prompts, steer.PROCEDURE and render_source default path both pointed at it for one run and restored), Corpus fields reword_steering_prompt/steer_examples_phrase/steer_subject_phrase (planted unchanged), steering_prompt sha256 in non-planted summaries only. Surprise: steer.render_source binds path=PROCEDURE at import, so patching PROCEDURE alone would not change the executed text; both are patched. Jev's own check already rejects over-budget proposals whole, so the cap is a safety net plus the reserve for few-shot arms. Results: unified specs 188 passed (was 184), make test 425 passed 8 skipped, planted replay copies (rounds 0,A-c,A-c+F x3 and final 0,A-c,F,F-rand,A-c+F) byte-identical predictions.jsonl and final-predictions.jsonl, 0 requests, clone git status clean. One existing spec edited: unified_emotion_test expected 'S4-S5' in the unsupported reason, now 'S5' (S4 no longer outstanding).
